the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def grid_of(h,w,bg,items):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in items:g[r][c]=v
    return g
# demo 1
x1=grid_of(16,25,7,[(11,18,4),(11,19,2),(12,18,8),(12,19,8),(13,17,8)])
e1=[(14,16,8),(15,15,8)]
y1=mod.transform(x1)
print('demo1', all(y1[r][c]==v for r,c,v in e1), sum(y1[r][c]!=x1[r][c] for r in range(16) for c in range(25)))
# demo 2

changed2={(r,c,y2[r][c]) for r in range(19) for c in range(27) if y2[r][c]!=x2[r][c]}
